We specialize in structural design, BIM modeling, and project management for industrial, commercial, and residential developments across Europe. Combining German engineering precision with digital innovation and international collaboration, we deliver sustainable, high-quality design solutions for the built environment. Company: gbc engineers Location: Ho Chi Minh / Da Nang, Vietnam Department: Engineering Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership: Mentor, develop, and manage a team of MEP engineers; allocate resources and conduct performance reviews. Project Delivery: Oversee multiple MEP projects, coordinate with stakeholders, and ensure on-time, budget-compliant delivery. Technical Oversight: Review and approve MEP designs, calculations, and specifications; solve complex engineering challenges. Quality Assurance: Implement QA/QC procedures and drive continuous improvement in engineering processes. Client & Stakeholder Management: Represent the company in client meetings, present solutions, and maintain strong relationships. Innovation: Champion BIM/digital engineering initiatives and improve workflows. Main Requirements: Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Mechanical, Electrical, Building Services Engineering, or related field. Experience: 7+ years in MEP design + 3+ years leading engineering teams. Technical Skills: Expertise in HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection systems; proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit MEP, Navisworks, BIM Knowledge of German Standards is a plus. Project Types: Commercial, industrial, residential, healthcare, hospitality, or mixed-use. Soft Skills: Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving abilities.
